source_gaps: The Microsoft Edge page has a Mac tab, but its text holds only Windows zoom steps and Ctrl shortcuts. No Edge Mac steps are planned and no Command-key equivalents were invented. The Chrome page has no mouse-only zoom steps, so none are planned. Excerpts and step wording come from WebFetch output (a summary), not the raw page HTML.

source_refs.title: Change text, image & video sizes (zoom)
source_refs.verified_excerpt: Next to Zoom, choose the zoom options you want:
source_refs.model_visible_text: On Chrome on a computer: 1. Open Chrome. 2. At the top right, click More. 3. Next to Zoom, click Zoom in to enlarge it, Zoom out to shrink it, or Full screen for full-screen mode.

source_refs.title: Change text, image & video sizes (zoom)
source_refs.section: Manage zoom levels for specific sites
source_refs.verified_excerpt: After you change the zoom levels of sites you've visited, to reset them from one place:
source_refs.model_visible_text: On Chrome on a computer: After you change the zoom levels of sites you've visited, to reset them from one place: 1. Open Chrome, click More, then click Settings. 2. Click Privacy and security, then Site Settings. 3. Click Additional content settings, then Zoom levels. 4. To remove a site's resize setting, click X next to it.

source_refs.title: Accessibility features in Microsoft Edge
source_refs.section: Make text larger: Zoom a single page (Windows)
source_refs.verified_excerpt: Select "Settings and more" in the top-right corner of Edge.
source_refs.model_visible_text: On Microsoft Edge on Windows: 1. Select 'Settings and more' in the top-right corner of Edge. 2. Choose 'Zoom in', 'Zoom out', or 'Full screen'.

source_refs.title: Accessibility features in Microsoft Edge
source_refs.section: Make text larger: Zoom keyboard shortcuts
source_refs.verified_excerpt: Ctrl + Plus sign (+) | Zoom in by 25%
source_refs.model_visible_text: On Microsoft Edge on Windows: Ctrl + Plus sign (+) zooms in by 25%. Ctrl + Minus sign (-) zooms out by 25%. Ctrl + 0 resets to the default zoom level. Ctrl + Scroll wheel up zooms in. Ctrl + Scroll wheel down zooms out.

source_refs.title: Accessibility features in Microsoft Edge
source_refs.section: Set a default zoom for all websites
source_refs.verified_excerpt: Under "Visibility", choose a zoom level from the "Page zoom" drop-down menu.
source_refs.model_visible_text: On Microsoft Edge on Windows: 1. Select 'Settings and more', or press Alt + F. 2. Select 'Settings', then 'Accessibility'. 3. Under 'Visibility', choose a zoom level from the 'Page zoom' drop-down menu.
